overview.description: The ProShares Ultra Solana ETF (SLON) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long sol, short usd currency. The fund tracks 2x the daily price movements of an index that measures the price of Solana (SOL). The fund uses futures contracts to provide leveraged exposure without directly investing in Solana. SLON was launched on Jul 14, 2025 and is issued by ProShares.

data.text: BETHESDA, Md.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--ProShares expands largest suite of crypto-linked funds in the U.S. with launch of SLON and UXRP, ETFs targeting 2x daily returns of Solana and XRP.
